title: Faraday cage test at the Monroe Institute

tellings.quote: So, we were at the Monurro Institute and they took me in the basement of the lab and put me in a Faraday cage

plain: In 2025 Chris Bledsoe, a man who says UFOs show up around him, was taken down to a basement lab at the Monroe Institute in Virginia, a centre that studies consciousness, and shut inside a Faraday cage, a metal enclosure that blocks radio and electrical signals. Bledsoe tells Michels about the test himself. The point of a test like this is to find out whether whatever happens around him can still reach him once outside signals are cut off.
